primitives.verbatim_quote: `docs/fable/aws/clean-rooms-demo/README.md` Rules: - Treat all AWS work here as local-only.

primitives.name: Access Control Policy Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Do not add AWS SDK dependencies without owner approval.
primitives.assumptions: SDK additions require formal authorization to prevent unauthorized resource exposure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unapproved SDK usage triggers immediate policy violation and access revocation.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's permission kernel; enforces access control policies via decision-engine validation before SDK activation.

primitives.name: Model Availability Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Treat all model availability as requiring current AWS/account verification.
primitives.assumptions: Model readiness depends on active account context and runtime AWS session validity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Expired or invalid AWS credentials invalidate model availability claims.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to GSI's model confidence calibration, verifying model readiness against live AWS credential states.
layer2.telemetry: Timestamped AWS session token status and model deployment health check.
